mapper.select: SELECT sp.student_id AS studentId, sp.user_id AS userId, sp.center_id AS centerId, sp.name, sp.age, sp.status, sp.learner_type AS learnerType, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(pa.score),0) FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.student_id=sp.student_id) AS overallScore, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(pa.match_rate),0) FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.student_id=sp.student_id) AS averageMatchRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.student_id=sp.student_id) AS totalAttempts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM therapy_sessions ts WHERE ts.student_id=sp.student_id AND ts.status='COMPLETED') AS completedSessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM therapy_sessions ts WHERE ts.student_id=sp.student_id) AS totalSessions FROM student_profiles sp WHERE sp.user_id=#{userId}

SELECT u.user_id AS teacherId,u.name FROM teacher_students ts JOIN users u ON u.user_id=ts.teacher_id WHERE ts.student_id=#{studentId} AND ts.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ts.created_at

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS date,COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM therapy_sessions WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND status=#{status}

SELECT h.homework_id AS homeworkId,h.homework_id AS id,h.title,h.type,h.description,h.target_minutes AS targetMinutes, DATE_FORMAT(h.due_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDate,h.status,(h.status='COMPLETED') AS done,h.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title AS exerciseTitle, h.version,DATE_FORMAT(h.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.homework_id=h.homework_id) AS attemptCount FROM homeworks h LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=h.exercise_id WHERE h.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,due_date,homework_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homeworks WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE homeworks SET status='COMPLETED',version=version+1 WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND homework_id=#{homeworkId} AND status<>'COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT he.homework_id AS homeworkId,e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title,e.category_id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName FROM homework_exercises he JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=he.exercise_id JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id WHERE he.homework_id IN #{id} ORDER BY he.homework_id,he.sort_order,e.exercise_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_exercises he WHERE he.homework_id=#{homeworkId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN speech_analyses sa ON sa.analysis_id=pa.analysis_id WHERE pa.homework_id=he.homework_id AND pa.exercise_id=he.exercise_id AND sa.status='COMPLETED' AND (sa.assessment_status IS NULL OR sa.assessment_status<>'HOLD'))

SELECT e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.exercise_id AS id,e.title,e.title AS label,e.instruction,e.input_type AS inputType,c.color FROM session_exercises se JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=se.exercise_id JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id WHERE se.session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY se.sort_order
SELECT category_id AS id,category_id AS categoryId,name,name AS label,color,description AS `desc` FROM practice_categories WHERE active=TRUE ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exercises WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND active=TRUE

SELECT e.exercise_id AS id,e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title,e.title AS label,e.instruction,e.input_type AS inputType,c.color, e.category_id AS categoryId,p.attemptCount,DATE_FORMAT(p.lastPracticedAt,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastPracticedAt FROM (SELECT exercise_id,COUNT(*) AS attemptCount,MAX(created_at) AS lastPracticedAt FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY exercise_id) p JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=p.exercise_id JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id WHERE e.category_id=#{categoryId} AND e.active=TRUE ORDER BY p.lastPracticedAt DESC,e.exercise_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.exercise_id) FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.category_id=#{categoryId} AND e.active=TRUE
SELECT exercise_id AS exerciseId,category_id AS categoryId,title,instruction,input_type AS inputType,target_phonemes AS targetPhonemes FROM exercises WHERE exercise_id=#{exerciseId} AND active=TRUE
SELECT item_id AS itemId,text_value AS word,text_value AS text,image_url AS imageUrl,emoji FROM exercise_items WHERE exercise_id=#{exerciseId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT item_id AS itemId,text_value AS text FROM exercise_items WHERE exercise_id=#{exerciseId} AND item_id=#{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_attempts(student_id,exercise_id,item_id,analysis_id,score,match_rate,attempt_type,homework_id) VALUES(#{studentId},#{exerciseId},#{itemId},#{analysisId},#{score},#{matchRate},#{type},#{homeworkId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE analysis_id=VALUES(analysis_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pa.attempt_id AS id,'word' AS type,e.title AS title,pa.score AS score,pa.match_rate AS matchRate, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS date,pa.created_at AS sortDate,pa.attempt_type AS attemptType,pa.analysis_id AS analysisId,pa.exercise_id AS exerciseId FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} UNION ALL SELECT h.homework_id AS id,'hw' AS type,h.title AS title,NULL AS score,NULL AS matchRate, DATE_FORMAT(h.due_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS date,h.created_at AS sortDate,NULL AS attemptType,NULL AS analysisId,h.exercise_id AS exerciseId FROM homeworks h WHERE h.student_id=#{studentId} UNION ALL SELECT c.conversation_id AS id,'ai' AS type,CONCAT(c.topic,' 대화') AS title,NULL AS score,NULL AS matchRate, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS date,c.updated_at AS sortDate,NULL AS attemptType,NULL AS analysisId,NULL AS exerciseId FROM conversations c WHERE c.student_id=#{studentId} ) h WHERE type='ai' WHERE type='word' WHERE type='hw' ORDER BY sortDate DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM practice_attempts WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND (#{type} IS NULL OR #{type}='' OR #{type}='word') UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND (#{type} IS NULL OR #{type}='' OR #{type}='ai') UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homeworks WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND (#{type} IS NULL OR #{type}='' OR #{type}='hw') ) counts
mapper.update: UPDATE speech_analyses SET status='FAILED',error_code='STALE_PROCESSING',request_key=NULL,completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE analysis_id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{staleSeconds} SECOND)
mapper.select: SELECT error_code FROM speech_analyses WHERE analysis_id=#{analysisId}
mapper.update: UPDATE speech_analyses SET status='COMPLETED',transcript=#{transcript},recognition_confidence=#{confidence}, match_rate=#{matchRate},comparison_json=#{comparisonJson},pronunciation_status=#{pronunciationStatus}, review_status=#{reviewStatus},engine_name=#{engineName},model_name=#{modelName}, analysis_type=#{analysisType},assessment_status=#{assessmentStatus},assessment_json=#{assessmentJson}, analysis_version=#{analysisVersion},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE analysis_id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE speech_analyses SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{code},request_key=NULL,completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE analysis_id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id AS analysisId,analysis_id AS audioId,exercise_id AS exerciseId,item_id AS itemId,status,pronunciation_score AS pronunciationScore, speech_rate_score AS speechRateScore,fluency_score AS fluencyScore,overall_score AS overallScore, overall_score AS score,transcript,feedback,created_at AS createdAt,error_code AS errorCode, evaluation_mode AS evaluationMode,target_text AS targetText,match_rate AS matchRate,comparison_json AS comparisonJson, recognition_confidence AS recognitionConfidence,engine_name AS engineName,model_name AS modelName, pronunciation_status AS pronunciationStatus,review_status AS reviewStatus,teacher_judgement AS teacherJudgement, teacher_note AS teacherNote,reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, analysis_type AS analysisType,assessment_status AS assessmentStatus,assessment_json AS assessmentJson, analysis_version AS analysisVersion,teacher_confirmed_json AS teacherConfirmedJson FROM speech_analyses WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND analysis_id=#{id}
SELECT conversation_id AS conversationId,student_id AS studentId,topic,status,summary,created_at AS createdAt FROM conversations WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET status='CLOSED',summary=#{summary},ended_at=NOW() WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND speaker='STUDENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET status='CLOSED' WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
UPDATE conversations SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{id}
